Method of Attack: Ransomware-as-a-Service operation with affiliates distributing ransomware; collecting and stealing sensitive data before encrypting systems and leaking data in stages to coerce ransom payment; threats to publish stolen data if ransom demands are not met; use of ransomware payments shared between affiliates and operators; emailing stock exchanges to pressure publicly traded companies to pay ransom
Indicators of Compromise: Leaked data archives with over 70,000 documents and 60,000 customer records
Threats and published stolen data on cybercriminal data exchange platforms
